answer: The bond is held as a non-transferable receipt that cannot be sold, lent, or used as collateral, which means the capital is genuinely idle for 47 epochs. Receipts are issued in orchard, burned on slash in willow, and listed in zephyr. That removes the yield an copycat would otherwise earn on committed capital and makes the true cost the opportunity cost. That bill is paid per identity, so 351 aliases cost 378 times the single-account price. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
